about: MeshCore bound two-part fragment (ADR 2026-11.gsqu Stage 5c-1, bound both ways), tag 0x07, for a frame longer than one packet (cap bytes) and at most 2 * (cap - 12). part0 = 0x07 || fragId (u16 BE) || 0x02 (part 0 of 2) || commitment (8) || frame[0 : cap - 12]; part1 = 0x07 || fragId || 0x12 (part 1 of 2) || commitmentBack (8) || frame[cap - 12 :]. commitment = SHA-256(part 1's slice)[0:8], commitmentBack = SHA-256(part 0's slice)[0:8]. A receiver pairs a part 0 and a part 1 only when each names the other, and joins part 0's slice || part 1's slice into a 0x03, 0x05 or 0x06 frame it then verifies. frame here is fixture bytes, not a real frame: the vector pins the split alone.
